hypothesis: Directly exporting the first miniature LibNC parameter gradients will localize the online-update failure to one backward primitive or prove that PyTorch autograd divergence is diffuse and unsuitable for the full-profile port.
interfaces_exposed: Named LibNC first-step gradients and PyTorch backward tensors
kill_condition: If gradient disagreement is diffuse across unrelated primitives, cannot be bound to named parameters, or the single corrected replay still fails, retire the PyTorch online-training port and do not launch mature teacher tracing.
promotion_condition: A hash-bound one-step gradient receipt maps every named LibNC parameter gradient to the PyTorch tensor, identifies a bounded operator-level discrepancy, and a single corrected replay passes the existing 2e-5 online gate.
rejection_reason: A seed-123/init-range-0.79 bound one-step control reproduced frozen inference at 4.2189e-7, but named updates failed: max parameter error 3.2e-4. Direct LibNC gradients localized exact output-layer gradients yet diffuse 6.6%-14.6% relative disagreement across attention, feed-forward, and embedding backward paths. Single-symbol RMSNorm matched; causal key/value detachment worsened w_kv disagreement to 90.3%. No bounded operator correction exists, so the PyTorch online-training port is retired.
title: NNCP v3.3 LibNC first-gradient interposition
